北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云偏凉，记得添衣保暖，别着凉啦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and cool. Remember to add clothes to stay warm and avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，外出记得带外套，别着凉哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and slightly cool. Remember to bring a jacket when going out to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗宜人，微风不燥，享受这美好天气吧！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant, with a gentle breeze. Enjoy this lovely weather!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天闷热，湿度较高，注意补水，保持清爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and stuffy with high humidity. Remember to hydrate and stay refreshed.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天潮湿，注意除湿，保持好心情哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and humid. Pay attention to dehumidification and keep a good mood.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天微凉，早晚温差大，记得添衣别着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and slightly cool with a large temperature difference between morning and evening. Remember to add clothes to avoid catching a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天风大体感凉，出门记得多穿点防风哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, windy, and cool. Remember to wear more layers when going out to protect against the wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天舒适，湿度稍高，保持好心情哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and comfortable with slightly high humidity. Keep a good mood.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天宜人，气温舒适，享受日常的美好。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and pleasant with comfortable temperatures. Enjoy the beauty of everyday life.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天湿冷，湿度较高，出门多穿些别着凉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and damp-cold with high humidity. Wear more layers when going out to avoid catching a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天舒适，湿度稍高，保持好心情。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and comfortable with slightly high humidity. Keep a good mood.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云寒风凛冽，体感0℃，务必厚衣防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and bitterly cold, feeling like 0℃. Be sure to wear thick clothes to protect against the cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天风大体感冷，多穿衣物注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, windy, and cold. Wear more clothes and protect against the wind to stay warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感微凉，早晚温差大，记得添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and slightly cool. With a large temperature difference between morning and evening, remember to add clothes.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天微凉潮湿，湿度较高，注意保持清爽。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, slightly cool, and humid. Pay attention to staying refreshed.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云风大体感冷，湿度高，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, windy, and cold with high humidity. Pay attention to wind protection and warmth.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云风大体感冷，多穿衣物，别着凉哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, windy, and cold. Wear more clothes to avoid catching a cold.
